Name: Inline Loading Spinner
Description: Small circular spinner that replaces a button label or sits beside text while an action runs.

Name: Button‑Embedded Spinner
Description: Spinner centered inside a disabled button, indicating the click is processing.

Name: Indeterminate Progress Bar
Description: Animated stripe that moves left‑to‑right when the exact progress percentage is unknown.

Name: Annular Indeterminate Spinner
Description: Continuous ring (no endpoint) used for background tasks of unknown length.

Name: Micro Dot Pulse Loader
Description: Three 4 px dots fading sequentially—fits inside compact UI like badges.

Name: Page Skeleton Header
Description: Grey bar that mimics a page title while content is fetched.

Name: Divider With Text Label
Description: Horizontal rule with a small centered word like “OR”.

Name: Vertical Divider Line
Description: Thin line used to separate toolbar groups or sidebar columns.

Name: Inset Card Divider
Description: Light border line indented from card edges, segmenting card sections.

Name: Section Spacer Block
Description: Utility component adding consistent top/bottom padding between major sections.

Name: Notification Dot Badge
Description: Tiny red circle (often 8 px) applied to an icon to signal unread items.

Name: Numeric Counter Badge
Description: Pill overlay displaying “7+” unread count on nav or tab icons.

Name: Status Dot (Online/Offline)
Description: Green, yellow, red dot next to avatars indicating presence.

Name: Status Tag (Success / Warning / Error)
Description: Small pill with colored background labeling state—“Success”, “Failed”.

Name: Decorative Corner Ribbon
Description: Folded corner graphic on a card for labels like “Beta”.

Name: Label Chip (Lozenge)
Description: Non‑interactive pill used as inline metadata (e.g., “Pro”, “Draft”).

Name: Color Swatch Sample
Description: Square or circle showing a theme color with hex code caption.

Name: Avatar Placeholder Initials
Description: Auto‑generated circle with user initials when no photo exists.

Name: User Presence Ring
Description: Colored ring wrapping an avatar, indicating active voice/video status.

Name: Drag Handle Grip
Description: Six‑dot icon indicating a draggable element in lists or cards.

Name: Handle Resize Corner
Description: Diagonal grip icon in bottom‑right of resizable panels.

Name: Shadow Elevation Utility
Description: Pre‑set drop‑shadow classes (0, 1, 2, 4 dp) conveying raised surfaces.

Name: Glassmorphism Background Blur
Description: Semi‑transparent backdrop‑filter panel for modern frosted‑glass look.

Name: Gradient Background Block
Description: Full‑width, responsive gradient section wrapper.

Name: Confetti Celebration Canvas
Description: Tiny canvas effect that bursts confetti on success events.

Name: Ripple Click Effect
Description: Material‑style ink ripple animating outward on button press.

Name: Shake Animation (Error)
Description: Short shake applied to modal or field on invalid submission.

Name: Tooltip Arrow Pointer
Description: Re‑usable arrow svg that attaches to any tooltip/popover edge.

Name: Hover Glow Highlight
Description: Subtle box‑shadow glow applied on card hover to signify interactivity.

Name: Empty‑State Illustration Bank
Description: Library of friendly SVGs (folder, magnifier, rocket) mapped to common empty states.

Name: Thumbnail Placeholder Icon
Description: Generic file‑type icons (PDF, DOC, IMG) shown before real thumbnail renders.

Name: Inline Code Style Span
Description: Monospaced text style with slight background—used inside prose.

Name: Clipboard Copy Button
Description: Tiny button beside text blocks that copies content with feedback tooltip.

Name: Scroll‑to‑Anchor Smooth Link
Description: Utility link that animates smooth scrolling rather than jumping.

Name: Print‑Only Watermark Component
Description: Faint diagonal watermark text that appears only in @media print styles.
